label: Diagram 3
caption: Diagram 3 Separation between hand washbasin/WC and food preparation area – two rooms
description: Diagram 3 is a plan (top view) of two adjoining rooms drawn within an outer rectangular boundary, titled "Separation between hand washbasin/WC and food preparation area – two rooms". A note in the top-left corner reads "See para 4.11". The left room is labelled "Food preparation area", and two diagonal double-line elements are drawn in the middle of the plan. The right room contains a water closet, drawn as an oval pan alongside a rectangular cistern set against the right-hand wall. At the top of the plan, set into the upper wall, is a hand washbasin shown as a basin with a straight top edge and a curved bottom edge, containing an oval with a small circle at its centre. The precise meaning of the two diagonal double-line elements is not clear from the drawing.
